claim_boundary: E-0031 measures independent numeric/sign/dash agreement on the already accepted and reconstructed MBB CDKT pages 3-4. Exact agreement verifies a bounded cell proposal; disagreement abstains. It does not verify Vietnamese labels, row semantics for blank cells, schema IDs, accounting equations, Excel output, human-gold accuracy or untouched-holdout performance.
development_note: The 0.95 agreement and six-cell abstention gates were selected after a dirty development smoke on this calibration block. They are calibration controls, not untouched-holdout thresholds or an accuracy claim. No expected value, disagreement cell identity, human review, schema ID or historical value is encoded in this control.
